title: Binary addition with two input tapes
notes: 1011 is on tape 1 and 0110 on tape 2. The heads walk to the right end, then add right to left, carrying in the state. Tape 3 ends with 10001: 11 + 6 = 17.
ops: mark 0|1,0|1,_ -> walk -,-,c R,R,R; walk 0|1,0|1,_ -> walk R,R,R; walk _,_,_ -> add L,L,S; add 0,0,_ -> add -,-,0 L,L,L; add 0,1,_ -> add -,-,1 L,L,L; add 1,0,_ -> add -,-,1 L,L,L; add 1,1,_ -> carry -,-,0 L,L,L; carry 0,0,_ -> add -,-,1 L,L,L; carry 0,1,_ -> carry -,-,0 L,L,L; carry 1,0,_ -> carry -,-,0 L,L,L; carry 1,1,_ -> carry -,-,1 L,L,L; add 0|1,0|1,c -> accept -,-,0 S,S,S; carry 0|1,0|1,c -> accept -,-,1 S,S,S
